understanding: Feature t_irq_err_chk checks int_o matches enabled IER sources with IIR highest-priority reporting and reset control plus LSR OE PE FE BI set per RX condition generating RLS interrupt cleared on LSR read. Entries 10-11 are QUICK_TEST inferred only not engineer approval. Depends on deferred t_lsr_status and passive t_irq_baud_mon int_o observation. Uses wishbone_slave_interface for register access uart_serial_data for RX error injection interrupt_output passive for int_o modem_control_if owned or tied off. Clock and reset are common UVCs.
preconditions: Clock runs at symbolic P_fixed; reset driven via reset with symbolic polarity and duration; expect IIR reset C1h no-pending [f_iir_reset f_iir_pend1]

DUT in DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 FIFO-only mode; divisor and LCR line format programmed via wishbone_slave_interface to symbolic SYM_DIVISOR SYM_LCR matching uart_serial_data data_bits parity stop_bits bit_cycles

Input ownership on physical ports: wishbone_slave_interface owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i; uart_serial_data owns srx_pad_i; modem_control_if owns or ties off cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i; clock owns wb_clk_i; reset owns wb_rst_i; observe wb_dat_o wb_ack_o int_o stx_pad_o rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o; addresses are actual wb_adr_i pin values
interrupt_output passively observes int_o; wishbone reads observe IIR LSR; no driver forces int_o; entries 10 and 11 remain quick-test inferred only
Symbolic addresses SYM_ADDR_IER SYM_ADDR_IIR SYM_ADDR_LSR SYM_ADDR_RBR SYM_ADDR_THR SYM_ADDR_MSR and symbolic enables; LSR IER resets unknown null
stimulus_steps: STAGE bringup: WAIT reset release; program SYM_DIVISOR SYM_LCR via wishbone_slave_interface; configure uart_serial_data to same data_bits parity stop_bits bit_cycles; READ IIR at SYM_ADDR_IIR to confirm C1h no-pending [f_iir_reset f_iir_pend1 f_int_single]

STAGE rls_inject: FOR err IN [overrun parity framing break]: IF err==overrun THEN fill RX FIFO via uart_serial_data then send extra char into shift register [f_oe_set]; IF err==parity THEN send char with inverted parity [f_pe_set]; IF err==framing THEN send char without valid stop [f_fe_set]; IF err==break THEN hold srx_pad_i at 0 for one char time [f_bi_set]

After each injection: WAIT RX complete; SAMPLE int_o via interrupt_output; READ LSR at SYM_ADDR_LSR via wishbone_slave_interface; READ IIR at SYM_ADDR_IIR [f_iir_highest f_iir_pend0 f_iir_rls f_lsr_clr_rls f_bi_clr]

STAGE priority_overlap: WRITE symbolic IER to enable RLS plus lower sources; create concurrent pending with RLS error plus THRE RDA timeout modem where reachable; READ IIR to observe highest priority 011 over 010_110 over 001 over 000 [f_iir_rls f_iir_rda f_iir_timeout f_iir_thre_src f_iir_thre_rst f_iir_modem]

STAGE reset_actions: apply documented resets: READ LSR for RLS [f_iir_rls f_lsr_clr_rls f_bi_clr]; WAIT FIFO drop below trigger for RDA [f_iir_rda]; READ RBR for timeout [f_iir_timeout]; WRITE THR or READ IIR for THRE [f_iir_thre_rst]; READ MSR for modem [f_iir_modem]; re-READ IIR to confirm next priority or no-pending
Cleanup: program symbolic FIFO reset; return srx_pad_i to idle; leave modem inputs tied off
check_steps: COMPARE int_o asserted exactly when pending source enabled by symbolic IER and IIR bit0==0; int_o negated when IIR bit0==1; FAIL on spurious or missing [f_int_single f_iir_pend0 f_iir_pend1 f_iir_highest]

COMPARE IIR bits 3-1 highest priority 011 RLS first over 010/110 second over 001 third over 000 fourth; FAIL on mis-prioritized; COMPARE fixed bits 7-6==11 and 5-4==00 [f_iir_rls f_iir_rda f_iir_timeout f_iir_thre_src f_iir_modem f_iir_fixed67 f_iir_fixed45]

COMPARE LSR OE set iff FIFO full plus extra char in shift register; PE set iff top char parity error; FE set iff top char no valid stop; BI set iff break hold 0 for one char time [f_oe_set f_pe_set f_fe_set f_bi_set]
COMPARE OE PE FE BI generate Receiver Line Status interrupt with IIR 011; FAIL on lost or aliased indication [f_iir_rls f_lsr_clr_rls f_bi_clr]
COMPARE OE PE FE BI cleared upon LSR read; RLS reset by LSR read advances IIR to next pending or to 1 no-pending; FAIL on sticky [f_lsr_clr_rls f_bi_clr f_iir_rls f_iir_pend1]
COMPARE THRE RDA timeout modem resets only as documented; use operational timeouts as testbench limits not DUT timing [f_iir_rda f_iir_timeout f_iir_thre_rst f_iir_modem]
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_iir_interrupt cp_iir_pending pending_0 no_pending_1 on every IIR read completion via wishbone monitor tap [f_iir_pend0 f_iir_pend1]

SAMPLE cp_iir_code 011_rls 010_rda 110_timeout 001_thre 000_modem and illegal 100_101_111 on same tap; SAMPLE cp_iir_fixed 76_11 and 54_00 [f_iir_rls f_iir_rda f_iir_timeout f_iir_thre_src f_iir_modem f_iir_fixed67 f_iir_fixed45]

SAMPLE each LSR error assertion OE PE FE BI on LSR read via wishbone monitor tap; SAMPLE RLS assertion and clearing via interrupt_output monitor tap [f_oe_set f_pe_set f_fe_set f_bi_set f_lsr_clr_rls f_bi_clr]
Dedicated subscribers tap monitor analysis ports; drivers never supply coverage; virtual spawn only with no VIFs or delays
completion: End after each RLS kind observed set plus RLS interrupt plus clear-on-read and priority overlap with reset sequence done plus drain_cycles flush
Abort on request_timeout_cycles operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing
Require at least one scoreboard comparison per test; basic single-error functional test first then overlap tests

facts.statement: IIR returns current highest priority pending interrupt
facts.quote: The IIR enables the programmer to retrieve what is the current highest priority pending
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR bit0 1 means no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR 011 is 1st priority Receiver Line Status for parity overrun framing break reset by reading LSR
facts.quote:
Parity, Overrun or Framing
errors or Break Interrupt
Reading the Line
Status Register

facts.statement: IIR 010 Receiver Data Available source FIFO trigger reached reset when FIFO drops below trigger
facts.quote:
FIFO trigger level reached FIFO drops below
trigger level

facts.statement: IIR 110 Timeout source at least 1 char in FIFO with no input or read for 4 char times reset by reading Receiver Buffer Register
facts.quote:
There’s at least 1 character
in the FIFO but no character
has been input to the FIFO
or read from it for the last 4
Char times.
Reading from the
FIFO (Receiver
Buffer Register)

facts.statement: IIR 001 source is Transmitter Holding Register Empty
IIR 001 THRE reset is writing Transmitter Holding Register or reading IIR
facts.quote:
Writing to the
Transmitter Holding
Register or reading
IIR.

facts.statement: IIR 000 Modem Status source CTS DSR RI DCD reset by reading modem status register
facts.quote:
CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.
Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: IIR reset value is C1h no pending
UART core provides single int_o interrupt output observed passively
LSR OE set when FIFO full and another char received in shift register
facts.quote:
If the FIFO is full and another character has been
received in the receiver shift register.

facts.statement: LSR PE set when top FIFO char received with parity error
facts.quote:
The character that is currently at the top of the FIFO
has been received with parity error.

facts.statement: LSR FE set when top FIFO char did not have valid stop bit
facts.quote:
The received character at the top of the FIFO did not
have a valid stop bit.

facts.statement: LSR BI break when line held 0 for one char time start plus data plus parity plus stop
facts.quote:
The break occurs when the line is held in logic 0 for a
time of one character (start bit + data + parity + stop bit).

facts.statement: LSR BI cleared on read generates Receiver Line Status interrupt
facts.quote:
The bit is cleared upon
reading from the register. Generates Receiver Line Status interrupt.

facts.statement: LSR OE cleared on read generates Receiver Line Status interrupt with PE FE same clear on read
facts.quote:
The bit is cleared upon reading from the register.
Generates Receiver Line Status interrupt.
